selection_rule.rank: ascending SHA256(UTF8(seed + newline + id + newline + gamefile + newline)); tie break by id
selection_rule.eligible: fixed edition Train minus every real execution or declared/reused historical Train identity in sources
selection_rule.insufficient_pool_action: Freeze inventory and ranking only. No fallback, no task_manifest, no final round assignment; await user boundary decision.

limitations: Archive presence is exposure evidence, not a success/failure label.
Copies across recovery archives are not independent executions; unique task counts are deduplicated.
No task outcome is used by the selector. No raw Train expansion or Selection/Test task is used.
Static JSON parsing and file hashes do not prove an environment reset will succeed.
